caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Hollan
caseNameFull: MISSOURI, KANSAS & TEXAS RAILWAY COMPANY v. HOLLAN
syllabus: Writ of error to review a judgment of the state court in an action for personal injuries dismissed, without opinion, for want of jurisdiction.
summary: ERROR TO THE COURT OP CIVIL APPEALS FOR THE FIFTH SUPREME JUDICIAL DISTRICT OF THE STATE OF TEXAS.
attorneys: Mr. James Hagerman, Mr. J. M. Bryson, and Mr. Cedi H. Smith for the plaintiff in error., Mr. C. B. Randell and Mr. Judson H. Wood for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction.
